options: The date a company starts actually running its real business in the new system
The day the project contract is signed
A type of quarterly update
The final exam for a functional consultant
questions.explain: Go-live is the date a company begins running its real business operations in the newly implemented system.

options: A special VIP account tier
A defined period of extra support staffing right after go-live
A type of security role for executives
The initial requirements-gathering phase
questions.explain: Hypercare is extra support staffing immediately following go-live, since new issues tend to surface fastest in the first weeks of real usage.

options: A financial audit of the company's cash position
A test of how well the user interface fits different screen sizes
Comparing what the company needs against what the standard system does out of the box, to identify gaps
A review of Oracle's quarterly update readiness notes
questions.explain: Fit-gap analysis compares business requirements ('fit') against standard system capability, identifying gaps that need configuration, process change, or extension.

questions.q: What distinguishes UAT (User Acceptance Testing) from a CRP (Conference Room Pilot)?
options: They are exactly the same thing
UAT is performed only by Oracle employees
CRP only happens after go-live
UAT is performed by actual end users signing off before go-live, while a CRP is typically a structured demo for stakeholders earlier in the project
questions.explain: UAT involves actual end users testing and formally accepting the system before go-live, while a CRP is a structured walkthrough/demo often held multiple times earlier to validate configuration decisions.

questions.q: What is an 'SI' in implementation terminology?
options: A Systems Integrator — the consulting firm hired to lead or support the implementation
A Security Identifier used for login
A Scheduled Interval for quarterly updates
A type of saved search
questions.explain: SI stands for Systems Integrator, the consulting firm engaged to lead or support an implementation project, as opposed to the customer's own internal staff.
